messages.content: Write a reference letter for Emily, a candidate applying for a junior software engineer position.

[Date]

Hiring Manager
[Company Name]
[Company Address]

Dear Hiring Manager,

I am writing to recommend Emily for the junior software engineer position at your company. Her academic background, hands-on experience, and technical skills make her a promising candidate for an entry-level engineering role.

Emily holds a B.S. in Computer Science with a GPA of 3.6, which reflects a solid grounding in the fundamentals of the field. She has applied that knowledge in practical settings. She completed two internships, one focused on data pipelines and the other on mobile app testing. Together, these gave her exposure to both back-end data work and quality assurance in software development.

Her capstone project, a recommendation system, shows her ability to take on a substantial technical project. Her technical skills include Python, SQL, and Git, along with basic cloud deployment, all of which are relevant to a junior engineering position.

Emily has also worked in collaborative environments. She has contributed to three projects in teams of four to six people, giving her experience with the shared workflows and coordination that software development requires.

Emily's education, internship experience, capstone work, and technical skills align well with the requirements of a junior software engineer. I believe she would be a valuable addition to your team and recommend her for this position.

Please feel free to contact me if you would like any further information.

Sincerely,

[Your Name]
[Your Title]
[Contact Information]

---
